provenance.claim_boundary: Two-state crossed conduct evidence; no human-learning or transfer claim.
Two-world repertoire traces only; the later one-world flat/bored promotion is excluded.

states.label: Misremembered exhibit
states.definition: The learner treats a public exhibit as saying something materially different from what it recorded.
include: The learner says a test was dry, clear, absent, or otherwise exculpatory when the displayed record says the contrary.
The mistaken recollection is doing argumentative work in the current turn.
exclude: A learner who remembers the exhibit correctly but disputes its relevance.
A learner who is merely unsure which exhibit is under discussion.

states.label: Finding fused with a personal stake
states.definition: The learner resists a finding because accepting it feels inseparable from apology, loss of standing, or another personal cost.
include: The learner links naming the finding to humiliation, blame, apology, or loss.
An alternative conclusion is kept alive because it avoids that cost.
exclude: A purely evidential objection with no personal or social cost.
A general grievance about not being heard.

states.label: Deadline demand
states.definition: The learner imposes a near-term decision deadline and demands a decisive reason or test before acting.
include: A clear time pressure or imminent action is named.
The tutor is challenged to supply one reason, check, or warrant within that constraint.
exclude: Ordinary impatience without a decision demand.
Mockery that contains no concrete deadline or requested test.

states.label: Mocking the tutor's register
states.definition: The learner ridicules or punctures the tutor's style, jargon, formality, or manner of speaking.
include: The learner compares the tutor's language to bureaucratic, technical, pompous, or otherwise misplaced speech.
The complaint targets how the tutor is speaking, even if it also advances content.
exclude: A substantive disagreement stated plainly.
A grievance about credit or standing that does not target register.

states.label: Lost thread
states.definition: The learner can no longer keep two exhibits, lines, or references distinct and asks which is which.
include: The learner explicitly says they cannot tell which object, line, or test a note refers to.
The confusion is about maintaining the thread, not rejecting the evidence.
exclude: A confident but false memory of one exhibit.
A request for extra detail when the existing distinctions remain clear.

states.label: Standing grievance
states.definition: The learner says their prior work, care, evidence, or standing has not counted in the exchange.
include: The learner asks what their contribution has counted for.
The complaint is about recognition or credit before further correction.
exclude: A personal cost attached to accepting a particular finding.
A simple request to repeat an explanation.

moves.label: Reopen the record
moves.definition: Return to the concrete public exhibit and correct the learner's recollection against what it actually records.
include: Names the exhibit and contrasts the learner's memory with its recorded result.
Invites or performs a fresh reading of the same record.
exclude: Merely repeats the conclusion or introduces a different exhibit.
Credits the learner without correcting the record.

moves.label: Split the finding from the stake
moves.definition: Separate what the evidence supports from the apology, blame, status, or other cost the learner attaches to accepting it.
include: Explicitly says the finding and the personal consequence are different questions.
Preserves something the learner was right about while allowing the causal finding to change.
exclude: Only reassures the learner or re-argues the evidence.
Treats the personal cost as irrelevant without separating it.

moves.label: Accept the deadline and set a test
moves.definition: Acknowledge the learner's time constraint and convert it into one concrete check that can bear the decision.
include: Takes the deadline seriously rather than resisting it.
Names a bounded, decision-relevant check.
exclude: General calming language with no test.
A long evidential lecture that ignores the learner's decision constraint.

moves.label: Switch to plain language
moves.definition: Accept the register criticism and restate the live distinction in shorter, ordinary language.
include: Explicitly drops or lightens the criticized style.
Uses a compact everyday contrast that preserves the reasoning.
exclude: Continues in the same ornate or technical register.
Only apologizes for style without making the content plainer.

moves.label: Untangle the thread
moves.definition: Put the confused exhibits or lines side by side, distinguish their roles, and restore a usable thread before pressing on.
include: Names both items separately and says what each does or does not establish.
Checks which item the learner meant after clarifying the distinction.
exclude: Adds another test without resolving the confusion.
Corrects one fact but leaves the two referenced items conflated.

moves.label: Give credit before the next test
moves.definition: Name specific contributions that counted before returning to correction or the next evidential check.
include: Identifies concrete learner entries, cautions, or distinctions that changed the inquiry.
Places that recognition before the next challenge or test.
exclude: Generic praise with no named contribution.
Moves directly to correction while ignoring the grievance.
